sentences: D[15:0] from S0 and D[31:16] from S1: the f32 is clamped to [-1, 1] (i16) or [0, 1] (u16), multiplied by 32767 or 65535 and rounded to nearest even **once, from the exact product** (SHADER-363).
Mesa ACO emits these opcodes for NIR `pack_snorm_2x16`/`pack_unorm_2x16`, which `nir_opcodes.py` defines as `fround_even(fclamp(x) * 32767.0 / 65535.0)`.
Emitted as `FClamp`, `OpFMul`, `RoundEven` and a convert, not `PackSnorm2x16`, whose rounding GLSL leaves to the driver.

The f32 `OpFMul` can land exactly on k + 0.5 when the exact product is just below or above it, and `RoundEven` would then pick the even neighbour; the product's error `Fma(c, s, -p)` is exact, so on such a tie the translator takes floor(p) + 1 when it is positive, floor(p) when negative, and `RoundEven` when it is 0 (an exact tie).
Away from a tie the two roundings agree, since k + 0.5 is an f32 there.

NaN gives 0, as `v_cvt_i32_f32` does: **measured** on an RDNA2 iGPU (gfx1036, SHADER-339), 74 of 74 NaN halves (quiet and signalling, both signs, payloads, in S0 and S1) gave 0 in wave32 and wave64 under the game's MODE and with IEEE 1, DX10_CLAMP 0 or f32 denormals kept (`tools/pknorm_probe.py --oracle hw`).

**The rounding differs:** the hardware rounds the exact product x · 32767 (or 65535) once, while the translator rounds the f32 `OpFMul` product and then `RoundEven`, so it is one off where the f32 product lands exactly on k + 0.5 (28 of 28 such near-tie inputs, both directions; `docs/shader_validation.md`, "`v_cvt_pknorm_*` NaN and rounding on RDNA2").
On gfx1035 (SHADER-137, `tools/int_hw_probe.py --oracle both`, wave32 and wave64) ±qNaN → 0, ±inf saturation and the round-to-nearest-even ties at ±0.5 match bit for bit.
NaN gives 0, as `v_cvt_i32_f32` does; that is **not measured on hardware**.

**Measured on RDNA2:** on an iGPU (gfx1036, SHADER-339/363, `tools/pknorm_probe.py --oracle hw`) 74 of 74 NaN halves (quiet and signalling, both signs, payloads, in S0 and S1) gave 0 and 28 of 28 near-tie inputs (both directions) gave the single-rounded word, in wave32 and wave64 under the game's MODE and with IEEE 1, DX10_CLAMP 0 or f32 denormals kept; the translator matches all 134 probe words in all ten runs (it was one off on the 28 near ties before SHADER-363; CPU-checked by `tests/semantic/test_alu_cvt_pknorm_f32.py` (the twelve measured near-tie words, ties at the scale steps, ±inf, ±NaN, subnormals, out-of-range values, 40 seeded pairs, abs/neg) and `tests/test_pknorm_probe.py`.

**Not checked through Vulkan on a GPU.** **Hardware-verified on RDNA2** (`gfx1035`, wave32 and wave64 via `tools/int_hw_probe.py --oracle both`, SHADER-137): ±qNaN → 0, ±inf saturation, and round-to-nearest-even ties at ±0.5 match bit-for-bit (the near-tie rounding above is a separate case).
